title: Submit an enquiry to HM Treasury
text:
Before you start

 Please check if HM Treasury is the relevant department for your enquiry. 

 All emails are read and carefully considered, but  we can only respond to messages directly related to HM Treasury . For all other queries, please contact the  relevant department, agency or public body.  

 We do not reply to messages that: 

 • contain offensive or abusive language or material

 • are selling or promoting a product

 • have already been answered in a previous reply to you

 • are illegible

 • are for information only, suggestions or comments without a policy question

 Please be advised that HM Treasury and its agencies will never contact you asking for money or personal details, if you have received this you may have been targeted by fraudsters, more information can be found at: https://www.gov.uk/government/news/fraud-and-scam-emails-or-letters-claiming-to-be-from-hm-treasury 

 For further information regarding what to do if you think you are a victim of fraud please visit the  GOV.UK  website, which is updated regularly. Scams can be reported to Report Fraud on 0300 123 2040 or online at https://www.reportfraud.police.uk/ . Useful advice for consumers on how to spot scams and protect themselves is available at https://www.getsafeonline.org/protecting-yourself/spam-and-scam-email/  or  http://www.fca.org.uk/consumers/scams .

 Here are links to further information which might be relevant: 

 • Information on the State Pension 

 • Pension Taxation 

 • Cost of Living 

 • National Insurance 

 • Inheritance Tax 

 • Vehicle Excise Duty 

 • Income Tax rates and Personal Allowances 

 • Business Rates 

 • 
 Bona Vacantia – part of the Government Legal Department that collect the assets of dissolved companies and other various ownerless goods, and administer the estates of people who die intestate (without a Will) and without known kin (entitled blood relatives) in England and Wales

 To submit a query to HM Treasury please use the contact form below:

 Submit an enquiry to HM Treasury 

 Please do not use this form if:

 1) You are submitting a Freedom of Information request. You can contact the  Freedom of Information team. 

 2) You have a complaint about the service provided by HM Revenue & Customs you can contact them directly at:  Complain about HMRC - GOV.UK 

 Answers to written Parliamentary Questions made to HM Treasury are available  here 

 Privacy Notice

 For more information on how we handle your personal data, please see our Privacy Notice
